reason: S1 renames the GIF end-of-data status from the suspension symbol `wuffs_base__suspension__end_of_data` to the warning symbol `wuffs_base__warning__end_of_data` and changes its status category. H0 still references the removed suspension identifier, so S1 + H0 cannot compile and cannot exercise GIF decoding. This incompatibility did not exist in S0 + H0 and is therefore commit-induced.
evidence: S0 declares and defines `wuffs_base__suspension__end_of_data` as `"$base: end of data"`.
S1 removes that identifier and instead declares and defines `wuffs_base__warning__end_of_data` as `"!base: end of data"`.
S1 changes `wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_frame_config` from repeatedly yielding `wuffs_base__suspension__end_of_data` to returning `wuffs_base__warning__end_of_data`.
S1 adds `wuffs_base__status__is_warning` and narrows `wuffs_base__status__is_error`, confirming a material status-protocol change.
recommended_action: Update H0 to recognize `wuffs_base__warning__end_of_data` under S1 and handle it as terminal successful end-of-data rather than as a suspension; then rebuild the harness to verify the renamed API is used consistently.
